name: igv-reports-skill
description: Self-contained offline HTML genomic-region reports (igv-reports / create_report) with cohort-aware driver, per-sample and cross-sample verifiers, and ONT 5mC/5hmC presets.

plugins.name: igv-reports
plugins.description: Cohort-aware driver + post-render verifiers on top of the IGV team's igv-reports (create_report). Builds one self-contained HTML per sample with embedded BAM/VCF slices and default annotation tracks; verifies structure, cross-sample contamination, and (opt-in) read-count anchors. Includes ONT methylation viewer presets.
